verdict.rationale: The evidence implies the source is publicly readable: the docs offer installation 'from source' (docs-44), a community user mentions very active contributors on GitHub (comm-1), and another embeds the core engine (Milli) in their own local indexer (comm-6). However, nothing in the pack names a license or states that it is open source. missing for 10: explicit statement of an open-source license (e.g. MIT/Apache), first-party link to the public source repository, independent confirmation of license terms.
